title: IT Network Engineer
description:
Responsibilities：

Based on architecture standards set by the headquarters IT architecture team, test and validate local products, drive procurement execution, and complete device purchases.


Collaborate with the headquarters IT architecture team and local service providers to complete the purchases, installation, configuration, and upgrade of network equipment and low-voltage systems (e.g. CCTV, access control systems, racks, and cabling).


Manage local system integration projects to ensure effective implementation of solutions as guided by headquarters' technical requirements, while optimizing execution according to local needs.


Develop and implement localized IT solutions. Ensure IT infrastructure maintenance and operations align with headquarters standards.


Monitor the quality of office network using tools provided by headquarters IT, gather user feedback, and design and implement corresponding improvements.


Track, manage, and Inventory local IT infrastructure resources (including equipment inventories and supplier collaboration) and resolve local application and service issues, and ensure the integrity of IT infrastructure.


Coordinate local service provider resources to ensure rapid problem resolution and efficient use of personnel, equipment, and time to meet project needs effectively.


Provide standard operating procedures and documentation support, regularly reporting progress on localized solutions to headquarters.


Requirements：

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, IT-related fields, or Engineering.


At least 3 years of experience in IT network and data center system integration maintenance.


Familiarity with asset management and vendor outsourcing management.


Familiarity with enterprise-level network architecture and equipment management. Knowledge of routing protocols such as Static Routing, OSPF, and BGP; VPN technologies including GRE, SSL VPN, and IPSec VPN; and wireless authentication protocols like EAP, PEAP, and TLS.


Proficiency in network and system monitoring tools (e.g. Zabbix, Grafana) and experience in operations automation tools.


Experience in managing CCTV, access control systems, facial recognition devices, and UPS systems is preferred.


Familiarity with key brands of switches, wireless APs, cameras, access control systems, racks and cables, with knowledge of their strengths and weaknesses.


Proven experience in developing and implementing IT solutions, with the ability to optimize execution based on practical requirements.


Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with suppliers and headquarters IT teams.


Fluency in both Chinese and English, or Portuguese and English, for effective communication is preferred.


Possession of relevant technical certifications (e.g. CCIE) or project management certifications (e.g. PMP) is an advantage.

title: Senior Installation Analysis Engineer
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Installation Analysis discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the Installation Analysis discipline. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the Installation Analysis team and other related teams and ensures they work within the appropriate guidelines and policies.



Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Direct Engineering team when assigned as a Project Coordinator on projects
  • Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
  • Manage own time to meet agreed deadlines and budgets and develop plans for short-term work activities in own area
  • Communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
  • Provide engineering support onboard installation vessels offshore, when required to do so
  • Be fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address the issues
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for Variation Orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close cooperation with other engineering disciplines, Planning, Fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in the preparation of estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and workhour estimates
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare Discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications, as required
  • Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Construction/Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare and review design reports
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • When assigned, assist procurement personnel in producing Discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing and reviewing requisitions, evaluating technical quotations and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Check engineering performed by others within the Discipline
  • Perform design verification through single-discipline check/inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Lead engineer apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary, and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Participate in internal, Customer, and third-party technical audits on engineering deliverables and vendor documents
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, design calculations, software, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, technical queries, etc.
  • Be aware of costs related to own work and of the discipline
  • In the Pipeline installation discipline, perform/review Pipeline Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for transportation and installation:
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • In the Structural Installation discipline, perform/review Structural Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • In the Naval Installation discipline, perform /review Naval Architecture Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation
  • Additional skills (preferred, not mandatory) - perform/review designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures such as:
  • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures
  • Loadout procedures and guidance during the operations
  • Construction lift analyses and procedures for activities such as floatover, stackings roll-ups, etc.
  • Weighing procedures
  • Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items
  • Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements
  • Trailer arrangements/operations, including drawings and procedures

Reports to: Discipline Lead Engineer

Liaise With: All Engineering disciplines, Fabrication Group, Safety Dept, Document Control, Procurement Group,

Subcontractors, Project Management Team, Vendors, and Customers

Supervises: Engineers


Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master's degree preferred)
  • 8-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards codes and guidelines as applicable for onshore and offshore construction
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.g., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.

A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.

More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Analista Contábil Júnior

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Hardware Test & Verification Designer
description:
At TOPIC ( in the Netherlands ) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer

with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting-edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?

“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”

Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems

What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.

Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:

  • Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
  • Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
  • Conduct and support HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
  • Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands-on programming mindset is preferred;
  • Work in a structured, plan-oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
  • Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Strategic projects in complex high-tech environments
  • Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
  • Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
  • Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions

This will make you better:

  • Permanent contract
  • An all-in benefits package (€62.000 – €82.000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
  • 26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support

This will keep you healthy:

  • Good work-life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
  • Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
  • Home office support for an inspiring work-from-home setup
  • Regular fun, social, and sports events

What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
  • 5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
  • Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
  • Proficient in Python (required); experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ is a plus;
  • Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
  • Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands-on programming skills are preferred;
  • Plan-oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
  • Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

description:
At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

We are #EnergizedByGrowth.

DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United Stat.

Responsible for software development projects for payment terminals and embedded media for Latin America.

  • Rapid understanding and development of new functions in the payment software platform, DFS embedded media products.
  • Represent stakeholders during the project and monitor projects with customers (internal and/or external).
  • Organize and plan the product backlog, conducting meetings with stakeholders to prioritize the items to be developed whenever necessary.
  • Responsible for the decisions of which teamwork will maximize the value of the product and add more to those involved, sets goals, prioritizes and approves quality, always seeking to ensure the highest return on investment.
  • Maintain the agile management principles followed by the team, supporting the Scrum processes with the team (daily, planning, review and retrospective), Kanban and other applicable methods.
  • Assist the commercial teams in the presentation of existing or new products, understanding of new demands and support in the generation of commercial proposals for specific new projects or improvements in existing projects, and should support the other areas of the company in the preparation of equipment and specific versions for demonstrations, fairs and presentations.
  • Prepare reports so that everyone is aligned on the status of developments, according to the processes and frameworks used by DFS for project management and new product development.
  • Coordinate SW releases to the field and provide support afterwards.
  • Train internal and external support teams, as well as DFS manufacturing areas in new products or versions that generate significant changes.
  • Create, maintain and disseminate the KPIs of the area.
  • Promote innovation, review and continuous improvement of the team's processes seeking process improvements, reduction of operating costs and maintenance of systems.
  • Document and assist in the implementation of processes that support the manufacturing, testing and quality control process of the equipment that involves our software/hardware solutions.
  • Monitor and support internal and external audit processes (ISO).
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc.
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.

Instruction

Complete higher education in Computer Engineering or related areas.

Specific Knowledge

  • Advanced/fluent English and Spanish;
  • Programming language: C# and XML;
  • Knowledge of cryptography;
  • Device connection (TCP, Serial, etc);
  • Knowledge of network (wired, wireless, routers, etc.);

Desirable

  • Jira;

  • GITHub;
  • Confluence;
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc;.
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.

description:
Resumo do cargo:

O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

  • Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
  • Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
  • Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
  • Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
  • Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  • Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  • Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Sales Executive - Shipyards & Shipowners
description:
Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners

Department: Sales

Role Summary

The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M&O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.

The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M&O’s solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Solution Representation

  • Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
  • Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards.

Business Development

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
  • Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
  • Expand M&O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight

  • Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
  • Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
  • Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions.

Sales Strategy & Reporting

  • Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M&O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
  • Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
  • Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.

Skills and Competencies

  • B2B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales.
  • Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long-term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams.
  • Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance.
  • Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes.
  • Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value-driven commercial solutions.

Experience Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in B2B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors.
  • Experience managing relationships with shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers .
  • Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects.
  • Background in mechanical, electrical, or marine engineering is a plus.

title: Executivo de negócios

  • Conhecimento sobre a legislação de concorrências públicas;
  • Experiência e participação de processos aquisitivos na esfera pública
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Conhecimento dos principais concorrentes no mercado;
  • Técnicas e habilidades para o desenvolvimento de vendas;
  • Capacidade de dialogar tecnicamente com áreas de TI e traduzir as dores do cliente em soluções
  • Conhecimentos em Planejamento Estratégico.

Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Experiência em vendas de soluções tecnológicas;
  • Conhecimento em TI e Estratégia de Empresas (abordagem por indústrias);
  • Experiência comercial nos segmentos de Segurança Pública, Defesa Civil, Justiça, Órgãos de Controle (Diferencial);

title: Pessoa Analista de Aquisição de Talentos Sênior
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros.

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

Missão:

Conduzir os processos seletivos da ENGIE Soluções e ENGIE Soluções de Operação e Manutenção, desempenhando funções que incluem triagem de candidatos, condução de entrevistas por competências e dinâmicas de grupo. O objetivo é atrair talentos do mercado e conduzir os processos de recrutamento interno, alinhando-se às demandas estratégicas do negócio.

Principais Atividades:

  • Conduzir alinhamento com o gestor requisitante da vaga, analisando as necessidades comportamentais e técnicas, avaliando a viabilidade de preenchimento interno ou externo, objetivando selecionar candidatos que sejam aderentes tanto profissional quanto culturalmente ao escopo da vaga.
  • Alinhar detalhadamente o perfil desejado para as vagas e definir as etapas dos processos seletivos em colaboração estreita com as Business Partners dedicadas às respectivas áreas clientes, garantindo uma compreensão aprofundada das necessidades específicas de cada setor, assegurando uma abordagem estratégica e alinhada aos objetivos organizacionais.
  • Conduzir de forma eficiente os programas de porta de entrada realizando avaliação de candidatos e atuando no desenvolvimento de estratégias específicas para atrair talentos jovens e promissores, alinhando-se à missão e valores da empresa.
  • Realizar entrevistas e testes técnicos e comportamentais, desenhados e alinhados ao perfil específico de cada posição, com o intuito de uma abordagem personalizada visando avaliar não apenas as competências técnicas dos candidatos, mas também suas habilidades comportamentais, garantindo uma seleção mais precisa e alinhada às necessidades da empresa.
  • Fornecer suporte aos gestores no que diz respeito à abertura de vagas e acompanhamento do status dos processos seletivos no sistema SEZAME, facilitando uma comunicação eficiente, garantindo transparência e agilidade na gestão das demandas de recrutamento.
  • Realizar análise detalhada das competências e do perfil dos candidatos, alinhada aos princípios de comportamento ENGIE Ways of Working (para todos os colaboradores) e ENGIE Ways of Leading (para posições de liderança), assegurando uma seleção que não apenas atende aos requisitos técnicos, mas também está em consonância com a cultura organizacional e os padrões de liderança da ENGIE.
  • Implementar ações estratégicas voltadas para a atração, seleção de grupos sub-representados promovendo um ambiente inclusivo, equitativo e diversificado.
  • Prestar apoio na compilação e geração de dados essenciais para os relatórios mensais das Diretorias de duas unidades de negócio, assegurando a disponibilidade de informações precisas e relevantes, contribuindo para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e proporcionando uma visão abrangente do desempenho do setor de Recursos Humanos no contexto das operações globais da empresa.
  • Colaborar ativamente na gestão das vagas, utilizando a planilha de controle da área de Talent Acquisition para extrair indicadores essenciais de seleção, contribuindo para a análise aprofundada do processo de recrutamento, possibilitando a identificação de áreas de melhoria, a otimização de estratégias e a tomada de decisões embasadas em dados concretos.
  • Acompanhar os processos seletivos e conduzir os candidatos até a etapa de confecção da proposta para os aprovados, seguindo parâmetros definidos pela área de Remuneração e, posteriormente, realizar o acompanhamento dos candidatos aceitos, encaminhando-os ao time de Admissão de Pessoal para dar continuidade ao processo de contratação dos novos colaboradores.
  • Realizar a condução de projetos estratégico e fornecedores chaves da área, assim como apoiar as iniciativas de EVP.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Psicologia e áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento das ferramentas do Office: Excel Avançado;
  • Sólida experiência na condução de processos seletivos ponta a ponta;

Desejável:

  • Idioma: Inglês com proficiência mínima Intermediária;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e ferramentas de gestão de dados similares;
  • conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de vagas.

A ENGIE valoriza e estimula uma cultura de diversidade e inclusão, com orientação para igualdade entre as pessoas, respeito pela vida privada de todos e é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e assédio.

title: IT Security & Compliance Consultant
description:
About you

You are someone who provide security, compliance, and risk oversight and drive the creation of the detailed inventory and classification of installed applications—ensuring the taxonomy defined in the charter is implemented (name, version, publisher, category, description, EOL date, plus owner/team fields for future phases), data is normalized across Systems, and risks are surfaced with clear next steps.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred) or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5–7+ years of experience in security, compliance, or Software Asset Management (SAM) governance.
  • Hands-on experience with Intune, NinjaOne, and ServiceNow SAM.
  • Strong skills in data normalization, taxonomy design, and software lifecycle/EOL management.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen eye for data quality and governance.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to coordinate across technical and business teams.
  • Ability to document processes, identify risks, and provide structured recommendations.
  • Advanced English proficiency to interact effectively with global stakeholders.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Detailed Inventory Build (Installed Apps): Lead aggregation from multiple sources; reconcile source differences; produce a single authoritative baseline of applications and versions for workstations, mobile devices, and servers.
  • Classification & Taxonomy Execution: Implement the charter’s taxonomy fields (Application name, Version, Publisher, Category, Description, End-of-life date; define placeholders for Primary Business Owner, Technical Owner, Team using the application for future phases). Ensure every discovered app is categorized per the defined category scheme and platform (Win/Mac/iOS/Android/Server).
  • Normalization Rules: Define and apply deduplication and normalization (e.g., normalize publisher strings, collapse installer variants, consolidate minor version drift) so each entry represents a canonical application + version.
  • Quality & Coverage Checks: Establish data-quality gates (required fields populated for scope; minimal “Unknown publisher” entries; alignment of device coverage to endpoints in scope). Maintain an Excluded Items log for anything out-of-scope with rationale.
  • Security/EOL Enrichment: Add security-relevant attributes/workflows (EOL flagging, vulnerable/high-risk categories, privileged tools). Create a practical CVE lookup workflow for later phases; prioritize EOL and obviously risky categories.
  • Validation with Business: Facilitate validation sessions with Managing Directors/Dept Leads to confirm the catalog reflects reality; capture deltas and residual risks.
  • Risk Assessment & Inputs to Roadmap: Document findings (unsupported software, shadow IT indicators, risky categories) and quick wins that feed the implementation roadmap/policies (policy drafting is later-phase).

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Our organization

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em uma ou mais nuvens (AWS, GCP, Azure), incluindo deploy, monitoramento e escalabilidade;

  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress);

  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacionais, especialmente PostgreSQL e MySQL.

· Identificação com os valores da empresa;

Entrevistas : Os candidatos finalistas passarão por entrevistas com os gestores da área, onde serão avaliadas todas as competências comportamentais e técnicas necessárias para a posição.

title: Analista financeiro
description:
️ Sobre a vaga

A Baggio e Carvalho Engenharia é uma empresa de médio porte, especializada em gestão e execução de obras comerciais e residenciais desde 1986. A empresa vem em um ritmo de crescimento interessante nos últimos anos e está buscando pessoas para somar e crescer com ela.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Administrativo de Obra (Financeiro) para atuar em nossa obra, um projeto com alto volume de controle e exigência de detalhamento junto ao cliente. Principais atividades da função:

.Controlar e manter atualizado o caixinha da obra e os reembolsos, garantindo que não haja virada de mês sem fechamento;

.Receber, conferir e lançar todas as notas fiscais da obra (APs, PPCs e PCTs) no Sienge, observando dados de faturamento, retenções e prazos de pagamento;

.Verificar se as retenções de impostos (PCC, IR, INSS) estão de acordo com o ensinado e devolver ao fornecedor quando houver divergências;

.Verificar o CNAE na nota fiscal do fornecedor, assegurando que esteja compatível com o serviço prestado;

.Conferir o endereço da obra nas notas fiscais, garantindo que esteja conforme o solicitado pelo cliente;

.Cobrar as apropriações da engenharia para lançamento das APs e controle financeiro;

.Emitir e conferir relatórios de pedidos de compra em aberto, boletins de medição e saldos de contratos, cobrando notas fiscais correspondentes;

.Controlar adiantamentos de fornecedores, solicitando NFs referentes a entregas e serviços;

.Enviar contratos para assinatura digital e realizar liberação no Sienge após conferência dos documentos;

.Lançar aditivos positivos e negativos conforme solicitação da engenharia;

.Emitir e conferir relatório “Administração de Obras”, montar RP e enviar ao financeiro corporativo com as notas e documentos exigidos pelo cliente;

.Acompanhar relatórios de distorção por apropriação e de saldos de credores, cobrando notas fiscais de fornecedores já pagos por adiantamento;

.Enviar relatório diário de notas lançadas e faturadas contra a Baggio;

.Acompanhar e garantir o envio das CNDs mensais e documentação de terceiros;

.No encerramento da obra, realizar o fechamento financeiro completo, assegurando que não existam saldos, pendências ou notas a lançar/pagar;

.Apoiar demandas administrativas e financeiras do gestor de obra e da equipe de engenharia.

Pré-requisitos:

Somos um escritório de advocacia full service, em constante crescimento, e buscamos um(a) Advogado(a) Sênior para integrar a equipe de Seguros e Resseguros no Rio de Janeiro .

Responsabilidades

  • Consultoria regulatória em temas relacionados ao mercado de seguros e resseguros;
  • Consultoria em fusões e aquisições no ramo de seguros, incluindo formação de sociedades e estruturação de joint ventures;
  • Assessorar em operações de compra e venda de carteiras;
  • Elaborar, revisar e orientar sobre contratos de seguro e resseguro, abrangendo cláusulas contratuais e todas as etapas pós-contratuais;

  • Inglês fluente;
  • Experiência mínima de 8 anos na área de Seguros.

title: Especialista de Recursos Humanos (Desenvolvimento Organizacional)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Missão do cargo:

Atuar como especialista em Desenvolvimento Organizacional e Business Partner, garantindo a efetividade do ciclo de gestão de pessoas e a construção de um pipeline sólido de sucessão. Ser responsável por conduzir e qualificar processos de performance, feedback e PDI, traduzindo dados em indicadores estratégicos que orientem decisões da alta liderança. Apoiar gestores e diretoria como parceiro de confiança, conectando iniciativas de desenvolvimento, diversidade e engajamento à estratégia corporativa, com maturidade, visão crítica e autonomia para sustentar a transformação cultural da organização.

Responsabilidades do cargo:

  • Conduzir e garantir o ciclo de gestão de pessoas - contratação de metas e avaliação de performance e comportamental;
  • Realizar Calibração - metodologia 9box; Assessment - avaliação comportamental;
  • Acompanhar e garantir feedback de desenvolvimento dos gestores;
  • PDI ( Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual) - acompanhamento dos resultados individual e em grupo, com mapeamento de ações e demandas de desenvolvimento e reconhecimento;
  • Mapa de Sucessão com nível de prontidão, com estruturação de agendas de retenção talentos e para as posições chaves;
  • Apoiar e conduzir localmente as ações de desenvolvimento dos programas corporativos: Mentoria, coaching executivo, ações internacionais, etc.;
  • Programas de desenvolvimento de times, como teambuilding, dinâmicas de grupos, etc.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Grau de instrução mínimo: Ensino Superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos e/ou áreas correlatas; Pós-graduação em andamento ou completo;
  • CNH B;
  • Disponibilidade para viagem;
  • Conhecimento em Excel e Powerpoint, diferencial Power BI e/ou painel de indicadores;

Desejável: Ter atuado com SAP - módulo SuccessFactors.

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Assistente Administrativo
description:
INTRODUÇÃO:

A Deep Seed Solutions é uma empresa brasileira com foco no desenvolvimento de tecnologias aplicadas a processos complexos de engenharia. Com base em uma sólida proposta de valor, a empresa acredita no uso eficiente dos recursos e na maximização do valor dos investimentos através da combinação de tecnologia com exímia competência técnica nas indústrias em que atua, permitindo a compreensão das reais necessidades dos seus clientes e o desenvolvimento de soluções que vão além da tecnologia.

Com o objetivo de suportar o crescimento de suas operações em 2026, a Deep Seed Solutions lança um processo de recrutamento, que tem caráter estruturante na formação orgânica de suas equipes e no desenvolvimento de novos negócios. Estamos seguros de que profissionais altamente capacitados e visionários são os elementos fundamentais para o desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias com alto potencial de impacto no bem-estar da sociedade. Se você se identifica com este desafio e acredita que nossa Proposta de Valor, Missão e Visão estão alinhados ao seu propósito, ficaremos gratos em receber seu currículo.

OPORTUNIDADE:

Posição: Assistente Administrativo

Quantidade de Vagas: 1

Localidade : Rio de Janeiro – Modelo Híbrido

Regime de trabalho : CLT.

Remuneração : Compatível com o mercado.

Benefícios : Tíquete-refeição, vale transporte, plano de saúde e dental e bonificação por resultados coletivos e individuais.

DESCRIÇÃO DO CARGO:

Buscamos um(a) profissional organizado(a), proativo(a) e com forte senso de responsabilidade para atuar em atividades administrativas e de suporte à área de Administração, Recursos Humanos e Qualidade.

A pessoa será responsável por controlar documentos, apoiar os processos operacionais e rotineiros da área de Recursos Humanos e garantir a fluidez das rotinas administrativas da empresa.

Dentre as várias atribuições, o Assistente Administrativo será responsável por:

  • Realizar o controle e arquivamento de documentos administrativos e de qualidade , assegurando conformidade com normas internas e externas;
  • Apoiar processos de admissão, férias e rescisões , coletando e conferindo documentos, acompanhando prazos e garantindo a comunicação com a contabilidade (departamento pessoal);
  • Enviar informações mensais ao parceiro terceirizado de folha de pagamento (alterações salariais, férias, benefícios, desligamentos etc.);
  • Fazer o controle de ponto eletrônico , banco de horas e horas extras , auxiliando gestores e colaboradores em dúvidas operacionais;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas , mantendo a documentação sempre atualizada e acessível;
  • Contribuir com o controle de contratos, notas fiscais e solicitações administrativas (compras, pagamentos, cadastros, cotações);
  • Apoiar a organização de eventos internos, treinamentos e comunicações corporativas ;
  • Participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos administrativos e de RH , com foco em eficiência e compliance.

FORMAÇÃO, FERRAMENTAS E EXPERIÊNCIA:

Formação de base : Formação técnica em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas ;

Ferramentas : Bons conhecimentos em Pacote Office (Word/Excel intermediário) ;

Experiência : Experiência anterior com rotinas administrativas e/ou de RH (admissões, folha, ponto, controle de documentos); e em empresas de médio porte ou ambientes dinâmicos

DIFERENCIAIS : Vivência com sistemas de ponto eletrônico e/ou folha terceirizada ; conhecimento básico em ISO 9001 , controle de documentos de qualidade; familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e fluxos automatizados (SharePoint, ServiceNow, Google Workspace, etc.).

COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS :

  • Proatividade;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Foco em prazos, qualidade e resultados;
  • Disposição para aprender e colaborar em equipe.

ETAPAS DO PROCESSO:

O processo de recrutamento é composto das seguintes etapas:

Análise curricular : O candidato interessado deve submeter o currículo no LinkedIn. A análise curricular levará em conta o atendimento aos requisitos comportamentais e técnicos e a experiência do candidato.

Avaliação comportamental: Os candidatos pré-selecionados na análise curricular serão convidados a participar de um processo de avaliação de perfil psicológico.

Entrevistas : Os candidatos finalistas passarão por entrevistas com os gestores da área, onde serão avaliadas todas as competências comportamentais e técnicas necessárias para a posição.

description:

title: Economista
description:
Economista Jr | Lobie - Transformando Hospitalidade em Escala

Lobie | Centro - Rio de Janeiro (Presencial)

O Desafio

Procuramos 2 economistas para construir o cérebro analítico da operação. Você vai trabalhar diretamente com o CEO/CTO em projetos que definem como alocamos capital, precificamos ativos e escalamos o negócio:

Projetos reais que você vai tocar:

Inteligência de Mercado & Performance

  • Tracking de performance operacional (31 meses de histórico, 107 → 1165 unidades)
  • Benchmarking competitivo (yield, ocupação, ticket médio)
  • Construção de cenários para expansão geográfica e alocação de capital

Relações com Investidores

  • Elaboração de informes mensais para cotistas e investidores
  • Tradução de métricas operacionais em narrativa estratégica
  • Preparação de materiais para reuniões de board e apresentações institucionais
  • Monitoramento de KPIs e construção de dashboards executivos

Análise Econômico-Financeira

  • Valuation de portfólios e análise de oportunidades de aquisição
  • Modelagem DCF para investimentos em studios e conversões
  • ROI de reformas e CapEx por tipologia de imóvel
  • Análise de custos operacionais e otimização de margem

Suporte Estratégico

  • Apoio em decisões de alocação de capital (comprar x reformar x operar)
  • Análise de viabilidade econômica de novos projetos
  • Identificação de gargalos operacionais e oportunidades de eficiência

Quem Buscamos

Formação: Economia (essencial) - cursando a partir do 4º período ou recém-formado

O que você precisa ter:

Raciocínio quantitativo forte - você vê padrões em dados, não só números

Excel avançado - tabelas dinâmicas, funções complexas, modelagem financeira

Comunicação clara - transforma análise em insight acionável (oral e escrito )

Autonomia executiva - não espera task list, vai atrás do problema

Resiliência analítica - lida com dados bagunçados, premissas incertas, pivots rápidos

Diferenciais que amamos:

Python/R para análise de dados

Power BI, Looker ou ferramentas de visualização

Conhecimento de real estate, hospitalidade ou marketplace

Experiência com modelagem estatística (regressões, forecasting)

Habilidade em redação técnica e storytelling com dados

O que realmente importa:

  • Você pensa em sistemas, não em planilhas - entende que cada decisão afeta múltiplas variáveis
  • Executa rápido, itera mais rápido - prefere testar 80% correto hoje do que 100% perfeito nunca
  • Faz perguntas difíceis - questiona premissas, aponta riscos, propõe alternativas
  • Ownership total - trata o problema como seu, vai fundo até entregar solução
  • Escreve bem - sabe como contar uma história com dados para audiências diferentes

Mas o valor real está aqui:

  • Acesso direto ao CEO e decisões estratégicas da empresa
  • Projetos de impacto imediato - suas análises viram decisões de milhões em semanas
  • Experiência em Relações com Investidores - você vai escrever para e interagir com investidores reais
  • Curva de aprendizado vertical - hospitalidade + real estate + revenue management + finanças estruturadas
  • Portfólio real de trabalho - em 6 meses você tem cases concretos para qualquer entrevista futura
  • Ponte para ecossistema - Lobie faz parte do grupo HausBank (tokenização, DeFi, mercado de capitais)

Como se Candidatar

Envie para ( ; ) com assunto "Economista - Lobie" :

1. CV objetivo (máx. 1 página)2. Mini-caso (escolha 1):

Opção A - Informe ao Investidor:

Você precisa escrever um informe mensal para investidores da Lobie. No mês, a ocupação caiu de 82% para 78%, mas a receita subiu 5%. Como você estruturaria esse comunicado para explicar o resultado de forma clara e estratégica? (Máx. 300 palavras)

Opção B - Decisão de Investimento:

Lobie tem R$ 5M para alocar. Opção 1: Comprar 20 studios prontos (yield 7%, gestão simples). Opção 2: Comprar 8 aptos grandes para converter em 32 studios (yield projetado 9%, mas exige reforma de 6 meses e R$ 800k). Como você estruturaria a análise dessa decisão?

Formato: Máx. 500 palavras ou 1 página. Queremos ver clareza de raciocínio e estruturação, não decoreba.

Sobre Meritocracia

Valorizamos diversidade de trajetórias. Se você tem perfil analítico forte mas não marca todos os requisitos técnicos, candidate-se mesmo assim . Preferimos alto potencial e fome de aprender a currículo impecável.
